notes.title: Playtest 2.0 - online co-op mode and new update
notes.content:
Today is the day, Dwarves! 🛠

Thanks to your feedback from the 1st Playtest we decided to speed up the second round! First Dwarf Playtest 2.0 will feature fixes that players pointed out in previous tests as well as the first alfa version of our online and local co-op mode and some new things to do on the island! Make sure your Playtest is updated to 0.253 version!

PS. We tried to fix as many things as we could in the time that we had and this is not the end of the fixes!

It’s our first try with co-op in First Dwarf, so please keep in mind that it’s still a work in progress. That’s why your feedback can really help us with polishing the mechanics of multiplayer!

When? ⏰

Playtest starts TODAY and ends in two weeks on the 6th of May 7PM (CEST).

Who can participate? 🤔

Just like last time, everyone can participate! If you had access to the 1st Playtest, you don’t have to request it again. There will be an update for you to download in your game library. 

If you didn’t request access during our 1st Playtest, you can do it right now and up until 6th of May 7PM (CEST). Remember that when the clock hits the ending date, access to the game will be disabled.

What’s N E W ✨

Thanks to all your feedback that we gathered (for which we are extremely grateful!), we fixed some bugs, text errors and mechanics. Now you can charge mana and fix buildings twice as fast.  

One of the main changes that’s easy to detect is making the buildings that are disconnected from the mana pipes glow red. This way it’s easier to tell if they’re functional!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/8f8b1b5a22055f3d943e994e04b9d6d7168b09f6.gif

There is also a new puzzle for Ragna added, so you have more opportunities to use her beautiful wings!

Play with your friend! 🐉🧔‍♂️

We know that a lot of you were waiting for our online and local co-op mode! And now the first taste is finally available for you to try!

In a single-player game you can switch between characters, completing tasks with the one with better skills in a given field.

In co-op, you can share a splitscreen locally, by making one person join with a gamepad and the second one playing with a keyboard, or you can invite a friend online and play on separate devices. Tru and Ragna have separate skills to develop and upgrade, strengths and weaknesses, so it’s important to choose the characters wisely when preparing to complete specific tasks.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/bb239e9bce104b0cb81a6a1f0be5ae7b91750389.png

You can change characters during the co-op gameplay, but you can’t control the same character at the same time. Mech can be controlled by both Ragna and Tru.

[previewyoutube=uKQD5H9-OSA;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uKQD5H9-OSA[/previewyoutube]

Camera shake slider

We acknowledged that many of you felt discomfort caused by the shaking of the camera. From now on, you can adjust that motion and if you wish, turn it off completely.

Please tell us your thoughts on this change! We hope that now you can enjoy the game with us.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/cb085232a828f582c9efb196e73d9a65f679d544.png

📜 Change log 📜

New:

 Camera shake slider
 Pop-up tutorial added for combo and high jump
 New system of communicating unpowered building (red glow if not connected)
 First iteration of development tree:

[olist]
 mech [mana refueling speed, more stamina, faster repairing]
 Tru [faster mech repairing, automatic mine improvement, automatic sawmill improvement]
 Ragna [More stamina]
[/olist]
 New environment puzzle for Ragna 
 Side quest: Eskoim Hammer
 New behaviors for settlers depending on the time of the day (sleeping, working, resting)
 Option for turning on/off tower radius display
 Added 2 new enemies (they are a lot tougher!)
 Added translation of some missing texts in a few languages
 New sounds added (monster nests, mech swimming and more)

Changes:

 Doubled the repairing speed
 Doubled the speed of mana extraction with mech
 Mech high jump and gliding improved
 Improved clarity and hints for Workshop quest  
 The way to the second island has been made easier to traverse
 Improved Ragna scouting mechanic
 Improved Ragna’s fire breathing and aiming  (still needs some tweaking)
 Experience points for quests, destroying monster nests, destroying monsters, etc. have been balanced with the level system in the game
 Mysterious flying object “upgraded” #spooky

Fixes:

 Adjusted audio in intro cutscene
 Some language errors fixed
 Names of some objectives corrected
 Fixed bug with Raven sending and the Port
 Menu sounds tweaked
 Mortar Tower rotation bug fixed
 Tru’s stance fixed while repairing the mech, Mech’s stance fixed while retrieving mana
 and some lot of smaller fixes

Your Feedback 🖱🎮

We’re counting on your feedback! Let’s create the game together and share some ideas! We’ll be very grateful for more of your thoughts during the second round of play testing.

Here is the reminder on how to do it:

First method is:

 First Dwarf Discord server

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png

You’ll find there a special Playtest category:

playtest-bugs - here you can send us all the information about encountered bugs (happens to the best of us), see pinned messages in that channel for more information, so we could have the best understanding of the problem and could fix it in the future!

feedback - that’s the place where you can tell us EVERYTHING you want after you played our game. Positive and negative feedback, all of that is welcome. You can tell us about the smallest things, regarding music, characters, dialogues, mechanics, systems… Every topic is a good topic, as long as it’s related to the First Dwarf Playtest. We can’t wait to chat with you about your experiences with our title! 

language-bugs - here you can post all language related errors. Please have in mind that the game is still in progress and so are the languages, so translations may have some mistakes. We apologize for that. They are in beta version, and will be improved with time. Texts and dialogues can also be altered later, if necessary. You can change the language in the game’s menu options!

opt-in-credits - here you can read the steps of what to do, to be included in our final game’s credits! It’s a little “thank you” from us, for all your help. By leaving your invaluable feedback, you’re becoming an important part of our big adventure! You’ll find there the link to the form we prepared earlier, where you’ll be able to drop your nickname. No offensive names of course, those won’t be included.

If you gave us your nickname in the last Playtest, you don’t have to write it again. 👍

Second method for leaving feedback:

 In the game itself, as seen below

Probably the fastest way to report a bug is located directly in the game. An automatic save file is also attached to the report you make (but you won't see it, so don't panic!). However, keep in mind that we won’t be able to respond to you there. We will receive the information, but to hear back from us or to engage in conversation, it’s best to use Discord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/8dc5c9fb5261fa46563efe193510f9861a50f77e.png

Third method to leave feedback:

 Steam Discussion on the game’s page

Fill the Form! 📝

We prepared a simple form to fill, which may inspire you in terms of what to be aware of while playing. After leaving your feedback, you can also write your nickname to be put in the final game’s credits there, it’s optional. If you gave us your nickname in the last Playtest, you don’t have to write it again. 👍

https://forms.gle/zkZLTsh76H6CePz37

Can I stream my game?📸

YES! Feel free to tag us and show off on our Discord server, we would love to see it! You can freely post about it on your social media. Even more! You can use our Press Kit, if you wish:

First Dwarf Press Kit

Earth Appreciation Festival

Today is Earth Day! It’s a very important date and we do what we can to remind everyone about it! Earth Appreciation Festival is a list of specially selected games that focus on a post-apocalyptic grim atmosphere of a future that we should avoid. 

But not only that! You can also find nature-focused games there, to appreciate all the good things about Earth.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/6f270c1e07445b42acc402fd94f90cd1eb7fd9bc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/5a2c07be1bbc1ddb7f5fbb47eaa27bb54d0e68a5.png

Are you ready? 🏁

And that’s about it! We hope that the changes we made recently will positively influence your experience. Let us know!

❤️ Add to your wishlist ❤️

Remember that adding our games to your wishlist on Steam is a wonderful way to show your support! We’d be very grateful if you could consider adding First Dwarf to your lists, as well as our upcoming prologue, First Dwarf: First Island!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2865680/First_Dwarf_Prologue__First_Island/


Thank you all for reading and for your support! We deeply care about our project and want to improve it even further! It can be possible with your help. 

Have fun play testing our newest build of First Dwarf and have a wonderful day!

Yours,
Star Drifters Team 🌟🚀

notes.title: Sign up for First Dwarf’s Playtests today!
notes.content:
Mages! 🧙‍♂️

As you may already know, currently we’re working on our new title. It’s an immersive action RPG, where you take on the role of a scouting dwarven engineer and pilot a giant mech in search of a safe place for new colonies. 

And it takes place in the world of Driftland! So if you enjoyed the twisted stories of Driftland: The Magic Revival, you may like First Dwarf, as it expands the lore of the magical planet. Explore the floating islands like never before!

Yes, yes, you read that right! We are organizing the first ever playtests of First Dwarf. 🛠
As we are entering the most intense stage of development, we’re asking you for your help. 

While the rest will wait for the official premiere, you can be one of the special players able to play before the release and help us shape the game into something amazing!

When will the playtest start?

We would like to start the playtests on 25th of March.

How to sign up?

Starting right now, everyone can sign up for our playtests! We enabled an option on our Steam page, where you can sign up for the testing.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714900/First_Dwarf/

https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYzY5eWRubjVpMTVnbXB3ajI5bmZzMGM3MTlwdWcya21jZnB5YzM4MCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/ocT3XQhaEOwlUiqQDQ/giphy.gif

In order to do that, you’ll have to grant us your permission and tell us your preferred name in the selected Discord channel. Prove to your friends and family that you had a great influence on our action RPG title. Stay tuned for more info!

So what do you think? Will you join us?

Make your choice and let’s hear from you on our Discord! See ya!

notes.title: Driftland Update - Are you a Driftland Specialist?
notes.content:
Mages!🧙‍♂️

We see a lot of newcomers here! But no matter, if you’re just starting as an Apprentice Mage or if you’ve got a whole prospering empire as an Archmage, we’ve got some news for you!

We made an update fixing some minor bugs occurring in the game and added the logo of our upcoming game, First Dwarf. It takes place in the world of Driftland and is an big expansion of its lore. Control dwarven scouting engineer Tru, dragon Ragna or powerful mech and explore the uncharted islands in search of a new home for your people. This immersive action RPG fuses quick combat with base building and tower defense. 

We absolutely love that universe and hope that if you liked the twisted and magical stories of Driftland: The Magic Revival, you will also enjoy First Dwarf!

[previewyoutube=U5C4TOFc8uw;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714900/First_Dwarf/

But First Dwarf is just the beginning, though! We would love to continue our adventure in Driftland, as much as you do! We’ve seen your petition regarding the making of a game with elf characters… What a nice initiative! Who knows what the future will bring.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/b6c77b608718e4e3eaceeb3ba3e7763a01a4729c.png

I finished Driftland… What else have you got?

We’ve got Nomads of Driftland - a standalone free expansion! As you may know, Driftland: The Magic Revival has a unique fusion of RTS, 4X strategy, and Sim genres. This helps you command all your units without micromanagement, thanks to the flag system.

https://media1.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExbmY4cHV2cHN5MngyajAxMTFrNmRva25leTQ2bnN2ejRoYjJrejRqZSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/4EOOfqSmCaXBInTt3X/giphy.gif

Contrary to that, Nomads of Driftland has a more classic RTS feel and is significantly different from the base game, as units are managed directly. It will be full of new experiences for you!

https://media2.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdmQ2cXAzMTZxbDBmMDY2MWU2NWE4OGYzMDExdzltcXFueGd1ZTN4eiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/hLHDqXUeXlBr92YqLC/giphy.gif

Unlike in the base game, Nomads of Driftland do not have a ruler and do not carry out orders like previous races. Also, new unit types and classes affect strategy on the battlefield!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1400520/Nomads_of_Driftland/

And if you want even more…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/a4de64829bfa12cddaca5ab9b5055c004b15724c.jpg

You can always check out the DLC for Nomads of Driftland called Nomads of Driftland: The Forgotten Passage, which adds 10 new scenarios to the game. Explore the world of floating islands to the fullest!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1436970/Nomads_of_Driftland_The_Forgotten_Passage/

Custom Maps

If all of the above is already no news to you, Archmage, you can download custom maps in the Steam Workshop. The fun never ends! And even more - you can create a custom map in the game editor and upload it to the Workshop yourself. ☝ Show us what you’ve got!

https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExam5xdjJqZmUzcGhwejg1Mnp6bTVnNzc0cTN6c2VmcWx5ZXNudGF0byZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/xdoKp1Zwul3CFtWY0p/giphy.gif

Bright Future

We are so happy that you decided to play Driftland and we’re always happy to hear from you! What characters do you like the most? Which game system do you prefer? What wild animal do you like to tame the most and what spells are your favorite? Tell us! 

And feel free to check out our social media and join our Discord servers, especially since we’re approaching the playtest stage for First Dwarf. Discord server users will gain access to it in the first place. You don’t want to miss this opportunity!

Oh, one more thing. It's the 14th of February…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/e311ac4c7c628c2d4d6e66228af8d4afd010017b.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/8b5afe298038642725abf9e9b2bf6aeb1d689210.png

May your islands float peacefully through the skies! ☀☁ See ya! ☀☁

Star Drifters Team 🚀

notes.title: First Dwarf Dev Update - Animal frenzy, New Gameplay, Floating Islands and more…
notes.content:
We’re basically flying in the clouds with Ragna from excitement to show you this update! 🌠

Dwarves!

News, news and NEWS once more! We’ve got so many things to share with you that it’s hard to choose where to start. ⭐ Get ready for the new update! ⭐

Oh, what a beautiful… what was it called again?

Who doesn’t love animals! 🐻 Big and small, furry or scaly, friendly and dangerous too! And what’s better than discovering new species? That’s exactly what’s happening in our studio right now - we’re on the lookout for creatures that the human and dwarven eye has never seen before. 👀

Here we can see this little fella. Very cute, isn’t it? But watch out! The tail looks suspicious… and can be hard to spot in the bushes. 🌿

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/7b68d2f5ab9e394c41d17b4dbfe5666e13edb947.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/b548394f5d02b9b7ce55479bd7192b8fe613842b.png

Not scared of the sharp tail? Well, look here. This big boy might be a bigger challenge. What challenge you may ask? 🤔 Well, in case it attacks you, that is… But it wouldn't do that! Maybe its horn is designed to open up ripe fruits laying on the ground and not helpless dwarves. Let’s hope for the best.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/b5c1a747b14d19cdf1e2cb9ec2ade3946e444acd.png

This one looks a little more friendly. Hawk? Tiger? Bear? You decide, we’re still thinking about that.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/332d7c5c115fd0e4f6d0966acd9e84d11754013b.png

As you can see, evil lurks even for such cute animals, hence the weird purple discoloration…
But don’t worry! If the animal gets tainted, we can make a potion or item for them. Some will need different treatment than others. Also, different species will give us special items for saving them or their nests as a token of gratitude! Those items can be used for crafting special upgrades for us or our buildings.

If you have any name ideas for these new species, feel free to share them with us in the comments! And don’t try to look for these animals in any encyclopedia, trust us, we’ve been there.

This one you should know

But Hey! We’re not reinventing the wheel with the next creature. Good ol’ dragon! Ragna surely isn’t the only one of her kind, right? Are they as helpful and cool as our sweet-voiced friend, though… that's unknown.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/42661490a0f17e99b4b5fc6fad30be706a4ccded.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/3d7337931b98eed70d3108123455780517d4ba9e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/d82d9178905532e9324b1891e4f4e6ceddf71c36.png

We’re also trying out different color palettes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/59b6c35ecdf8c7df7c4a615037716cefd66bfcd2.png

But living species are not the only thing we have new concepts of. Here you can take a look at the destroyed ancient Escoim mana well, not just a regular one that you can build! It’s a crucial part of one of the island quests and an insight into the Driftland lore.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/b8238dce816bda6c0988939f39d6bee96d3260ef.png

Now you may think. So many animals, what is this… Pet Simulator game? Well, no. But what if?...

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/035462dfc6209b5355b6457d040299087051a293.jpg

…Would you play it?

Fresh Screenshots

But enough with the jokes! Important information time: you may have already noticed, but we have changed some screenshots on our Steam Page! Updated with the newest builds, you can take a look and see for yourself how First Dwarf is improving from day to day! Here are some examples, but make sure to see them all later.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/87749659c4dcf998f6db859beae1151f561a4dfc.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/bf6e0263c87dd34491581184b8208fb720c0732e.png

More Islands

We’re intensely working on adding more floating islands to the world. The number of them is…

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/08b0e498a33494aa4e7312d587ad5bf53356f980.png

…SECRET. DUH! What fun would it be, if you knew from the start how many islands you have to discover. Please. This will be a surprise!

But in all seriousness, recently we’ve been upgrading all the islands and adding all the little details to them, so you’ll have a lot of wonderful experiences on each of them.

Gameplay Surprise for our Discord Members

Images are cool, but we all know that the power that moving footage contains is irreplaceable! So if you want to watch new gameplay of our game, we uploaded it on our discord 😄 Our team often shows off the fruits of their labor there, so if you want to be up to date or just chat with us, feel free to join in!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/c511ca9d5cb9765b15ae6c787b067727695b19db.png

Wallpaper, anyone?

If you’re bored of your current wallpaper, we got you. Check out this magical new Key Art we have! 🎨 What dangers wander on the floating islands? Doesn’t matter, Tru will manage to beat them all!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/2907db8cd1e2bbd255eb602f9b358d6e8a3d603e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42893252/4a71e0da7af805d49e8203a84ff53737eb07ff51.png

Wrap up!

And for now that’s all that we can share with you! As always, thank you for your support and make sure to join our social media (Facebook, Twitter/X, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok).

https://media4.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExcXBpcng1a200dDQ2YnVxNXFscW95ZnR0ajV4bXJzMndqNm82aHRrZyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/6Gt0MCNVUXOxstjeTY/source.gif

You won’t miss a thing that way!

Take care! 
Star Drifters 🚀

notes.title: First Dwarf - dev update - IGN Exclusive Trailer
notes.content:
Hello!

It's been a while since we last connected, but that's because we had a lot going on lately. Most importantly, we're working on developing First Dwarf! We want to make sure it's as close to perfection as possible by the time it is released.

Additionally, we've been traveling a lot. As you’re reading this, we're still recovering after big shows - Gamescom, PAX West and Poznań Game Arena, where players could try out for themselves the demo version of our game! 2 major events across the ocean from each other are tough to manage, but definitely worth every while!

New trailer!

We would like to proudly announce a trailer for First Dwarf, which was first exclusively shown by IGN during their Gamescom showcase! Check it out below!

[previewyoutube=U5C4TOFc8uw;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can see, there are several new shots, and we've carefully selected scenes in order to present as many of the game's features as we can. After all, we're not limited to just one gameplay mechanic. Tru can gather resources, build a settlement, explore unknown lands, and, of course, he must fight for his safety!

Farewell for now...

… Speaking about opportunities, remember that our Discord server is always worth joining. We're getting closer to launching a limited testing phase for gamers, so if you would like to be among the lucky ones, click the banner below.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30811282/8b5afe298038642725abf9e9b2bf6aeb1d689210.png

Apart from that, you can also find us on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, LinkedIn, and on TikTok. Follow us in each of these places to stay up to date with First Dwarf! It's definitely worth it!

With respect,
Star Drifters

notes.title: Star Drifters recap #2 🚀
notes.content:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/ce120de2b04e5ae22f7e23aa739c7c68d6082dfa.png

Hello everyone! 👋

The year 2022 is now a melody of the past.
We would like to thank all of you guys for supporting us since day one! 🙏

Without further ado - let’s check out what happened in our camp during the second half of ‘22. Let’s go! 🏃‍♂️

⚒️ First Dwarf (...and some gaming events here and there! 🎮)

In case you missed it - First Dwarf is our upcoming Action RPG set in the world of Driftland. That’s why you can read about it on Driftland: The Magic Revival Steam card.

You’ll be able to pet a good boi in the game. Mhm. That’s right! 🐕

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/2291dda4316057dd3f8a5dd9c95a3dfaa99cb714.png

Now, let’s talk about the asymmetrical co-op 🐉 that we’re implementing in First Dwarf.

https://media1.giphy.com/media/72TI5I4dhzpNY9lM9M/giphy.gif?cid=790b7611ccbf33c850aabc58ee4639c1cad792f6f0e8cd80&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g

🧑‍🤝‍🧑 In co-op, players will be able to take control over the mech or one of its pilots: Tru or Ragna. Each of them has its own, separate skills to develop and upgrade. All characters have their strengths and weaknesses so it’s important to choose the characters wisely when preparing to complete certain tasks.

🧑‍ In a single-player game, the player can switch between characters, completing tasks with the one with better skills in a given field. Tru, Ragna, and the Mech will have different skill trees. Tru will be a better Mecha pilot, Ragna can e.g. fly, and the Mech can be treated as a kind of armored vehicle, so without a pilot it will not work.

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/c33ff6eb2732f53b648d63ea4d3f2deece9099f4.png

It’s important to say that implementing the asymmetrical co-op would not be possible without the Game Prototype Design Competition 2022 in which we were awarded! 🏆

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/96151434e644ea6a3661c55b5de7d2018f85f72c.jpg

The competition mentioned above helped us create some new mechanics for First Dwarf. Those mechanics evolved into a full-fledged, asymmetrical co-op mode of the game, which we implemented in its build! Once again, thank you to the co-organizers of the competition: Ministry of Culture and National Heritage of Poland, Centrum GovTech Poland, and CRPK, as well as Copernicus Game Jam 2022 - during which the diplomas 📜 were handed over and everyone who supported us along the way. 

We showed our upcoming action RPG at many gaming 🎮 events, both digital and held in “real” places. Just to name a few:
- PAX West;
- Poznań Games Arena (PGA);
- Indie Cade;
- DreamHack Beyond Indie Showcase;
- MIX Next 2022;
- Dev.Play;
- #PitchYaGame.

It’s time to focus on 3️⃣ of them. 

🚏 First stop  - PAX West. 

Lots of you came to our booth to check out an early build of our game. Thank you for that! See you next year! 🤜🤛

Your reactions surpassed our expectations, and the feedback provided will certainly influence the further development of the game, already at this stage. It was 4 days full of interesting conversations, laughter and a unique atmosphere created by countless players, cosplayers, journalists, or industry representatives.🤝

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/928de1dd561f0477b0514cba94e17747378edf6e.jpg

🚏 Second stop - Poznań Games Arena (PGA).

In Poznań, we were showing First Dwarf, Scorchlands, Brewpub Simulator, and Lumencraft. PGA was such a blast! We felt your enjoyment brought to your faces by our upcoming games. Just look at Kuba, one of the members of our team - his smile does not lie 😊

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/43b9e42e2687c21e624f24477350e8b8d03887e2.png

🚏 The last stop - Dev.Play.

It’s a yearly celebration of indie games and their developers. Game creators from all over the world come to Bucharest to present their titles and experiences. The event ended with an award gala. First Dwarf received 3 awards: Best Game of the Show, Best Visuals, and Most Popular Game. 🏆 Thank y’all! 🙏

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/d62bed11cbef9823c12ab7d5bdd4e8ee557cdeb0.jpg

To wrap up the First Dwarf chapter of this recap we want to write about the key role of our IGN - Exclusive Announcement Trailer posted on IGN’s YouTube channel was viewed more than 285k times. There are also more than 5.4k thumbs up 👍 under the video! 📺

[previewyoutube=ZKC-fx7Vl88;full][/previewyoutube]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1714900/First_Dwarf/

🐦 Scorchlands

Who won’t fall in love with birdlike Giwis, running around through the hexes? The game’s a wholesome and adorable city builder.

https://media1.giphy.com/media/XGAo3gKe9wJPDmwRMi/giphy.gif?cid=790b76115356d922e1b3d55f775e11e3307688c468f38669&rid=giphy.gif&ct=g

Play the demo version - is available for free here, on Steam!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1090100/Scorchlands/

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/1fd3fa564ef3e26c57206c5fd6954b37f5eb4c47.png

At this point, we can say that developers from Ringlab ⚗️ are aiming for publishing more Steam News about in-game mechanics. When we’re writing these words, three of them are available as we speak: How the protagonist Giwi hatched, How to build your colony, and Gameplay Insight #1: Summoning the Nexus.

Stay tuned ! More of them will be published during January and February of 2023.

Also, the game received a warm welcome during #TurnBasedFest 2022! 😎

🕷️ Lumencraft

The full release of this unique mix of a top-down shooter with base building and roguelike mechanisms is just around the corner! Nonetheless, we’re not spoiling the release date at the moment. That’s not the only great news - something big is coming to the game. We bet you weren’t expecting this. Jump on the hype train, but stay calm. For now, let’s go down. Together. ⏬

https://media0.giphy.com/media/WnnTLWpE7w6uV8RdOZ/giphy.gif

The developers from 2Dynamic Games are constantly tweaking and upgrading the game’s build. You can help them by completing the survey they made - we’ll be very grateful for the feedback! It’s called Discord 🎧 survey, because the game’s community was the first one to answer the questions mentioned in it.

👉 Link to Lumencraft survey: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSckMJ-2HMumj5rPd_i2Up0bxT3CRyQvZzWpmKmvBQTfKDTLNg/viewform

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/9473fa44bdee56b1b582414221b127704082baf4.png

One of the most important moments during the Early Access of Lumencraft was taking a different approach to the game's build. The experimental update published a few months ago left the beta stage. It's now living its new life - the developers called it Giga Update. 

Lumencraft is reshaping every once in a while - two bigger updates and one smaller update were released since the release of Giga Update. There’s a lot of fresh content in the game - you should play it now, especially if you spent some time with Lumencraft a few months ago. It truly is worth revisiting! 🔁

🍻 Brewpub Simulator

There was a first, official playtest of the game - we’re glad how many of you decided to check out what it’s like to run a virtual pub and brew some virtual ale! A playable build of the game was presented to European audiences for the first time during PGA 2022. Thanks for playing it, we know what works and what needs some tweaking here and there! 🍺

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/ffab0e73146aaa9b580a0e7165fbeccbcd7cc745.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755180/Brewpub_Simulator/

🏢 Danger Scavenger 

Our skyscraper roguelite shooter is out now on Epic Games Store! 🎉

https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/cf33bb6ae85f37b45f39d459367dd2249cf56bf8.png

Just a reminder - Danger Scavenger is available on PC, PS4, XONE, Nintendo Switch, Atari VCS, and XSX. It’s also a Steam Deck verified game - give it a try on one of the handhelds, and you’ll fall in love with this fast-paced gunslinger action! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169740/Danger_Scavenger/

This is not the last word we said speaking about publishing our games’ catalog on Epic Games Store - more titles will follow soon. At this point, you can wishlist First Dwarf ⚒️ and Scorchlands 🐦 on this platform! 

That’s all for today.
Great things are here, but also great things are yet to come.
2023 will be ours! 

Don’t forget to support IndieDev! 🕹️

Much love, 
Star Drifters 🚀

notes.title: Star Drifters recap
notes.content:
https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/37547bab3d30a82d7db45227a874bfff4b8d5fde.png

Hello everyone, 👋

you probably wonder why there’s a graphic with a screen taken from the Nintendo Switch 🎮 version of Danger Scavenger. The answer is simple - we wanted to make an announcement summarizing our work done between January and July of 2022 - when we’re writing these words, Driftland is still our most popular franchise. 🌲

Unfortunately, nothing really happened during this period in Driftland camp. Nonetheless, you can get the game in many discounts that pop up every once in a while (usually during Steam/GOG offers/events). But, y’know, there’s always something cookin’. ♨ Be patient.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/2f8424598909bae3c60b575fc912d21ea396a31e.png

https://store.steampowered.com/app/718650/Driftland_The_Magic_Revival/

Danger Scavenger

That’s where the fun starts. First of all - we’re flattered that DS is featured on the back of the Atari VCS box. Ta-da! 🎉

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/68ec192ba36b75171cc891d762706687b362de7d.png

When Steam Deck was on its way, we did everything to make sure that the game would run perfectly on the “second” handheld from day one. After that, we received an official Steam Deck verification in May. Speaking about the “first” handheld, just a reminder - Danger Scavenger is available on PC, PS4, XONE, Switch, VCS and XSX. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1169740/Danger_Scavenger/

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/c15dfd345141b02b9005abd96832472137d76cb0.jpg

We’re always looking for new ways of approaching the titles that we already published. When we started talking with the Tilt Five team, we knew that their Holographic Gaming System would be a great place for a skyscraper-based roguelike. That’s why we made a dedicated DLC to bring the catchphrase “a new level of the 3D vibrant holographic environment" to DS rooftops! 🌆

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/ed22b76333715d0e33298d2ff77347e56d27d0f0.jpg

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/20123869e38e7254ea40fdd7bd43f147f7d12d26.jpg

Lumencraft

When devs from 2Dynamic Games started the playtests, we were convinced that approx. 200 people will check out the game during the two weeks of that phase. Well, there were 1312 participants. The feedback submitted by playtesters gave us a new perspective on the game. We knew that we chose the right project for publishing.

The Lumencraft section of this Steam announcement will be the longest one, because the game’s still in Early Access and currently it’s a project no. 1 in our catalog. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1713810/Lumencraft/

After the first week of EA we reached the 20k copies milestone. None of us expected that this will happen so fast, so Kuba Wójcik came up with a meme idea.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/be9a75f964c9606a8e5a8f469a4aa6c4266c71f7.png

We won’t share how many copies were sold, but we can say that as the indie publishers - we’re satisfied. 😏

Today, exactly 3 months after the start of Early Access (which happened April 13th, 2022) we would like to thank everyone who wrote a review on Steam. The numbers speak for themselves. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/37957996/34129bc80a88a4be9bad0b73d6afeac1e0ffac06.png

During the playtests, “2Ds” organized the MAKE A MAP, WIN A PRIZE contest. 10 maps were published via Steam Workshop - 3 guys won Danger Scavenger and Driftland: The Magic Revival Steam keys. The ideas behind the contest were continued in the Maps Shootout series. When we’re writing these words there are 123 maps submitted to the Workshop. 🤯

Lots of them are truly pieces of art that reshape Lumencraft’s gameplay. The summary of all Maps Shootouts installments can be found in our Stories highlights on our Instagram.

What’s more, the game was shown at this year’s:
- European Game Showcase during GDC;
- PAX East;
- Digital Dragons 🐲.

To this day, the 2Dynamic Games team is working closely with the game’s community. When Early Access starts (after the playtests), the developers published:
- 3 hotfixes;
- 4 small updates;
- two major updates;
- and we’re pretty much sure we forgot about something. 💊

They added new weapons, buildings, monsters, maps and scenarios, textures, new UI, and fixed A LOT. Lumencraft is now more approachable to semi-casual players, but it does not collide with the hardcore players - there are extremely hard maps available to enjoy (or suffer a bit). 😈 

That’s all for today.
The second recap will be published at the end of 2022.
Or maybe at the beginning of 2022?

Let’s see what happens. Great things are here, but also great things are yet to come.

Support the IndieDev!
Star Drifters 🚀

notes.title: Hello World!
notes.content:
We are pleased to invite you to the planet Driftland, where you will play as Nomads fighting for their freedom!


The promise to restore civilization to its former shape and return to the times of splendor overcame sadness. It filled the hearts of Driftland's inhabitants with new hope and energy. Determination for action diverted attention from the numerous conflicts between quarrelsome mage-rulers and various injuries sustained by those who did not give in to their will.

Outlaw rebels, by the mage-rulers called Nomads, are exterminated and treated as barbarians. They believe that the new order is an attempt to restore balance in shape that has once destroyed the planet.

Now, the Nomads must fight to defend their values and survive.

About Nomads of Driftland
Nomads do not have a ruler and do not carry out orders like other races in the base game. Units are managed directly, like in classic RTS games. New unit types/classes affect strategy on the battlefield.
Nomads of Driftland is an RTS game initially created as an add-on to Driftland: The Magic Revival. Since it is significantly different from the base game, we decided to release it as a standalone expansion and make it available for free.
[previewyoutube=xpmCkkBdr60;full][/previewyoutube]

Map Editor and Workshop integration
Map Editor allows you to create your own maps with islands of unusual shapes and arrangements. In turn, thanks to the Workshop, you will be able to easily share your maps and download maps created by other players.
[previewyoutube=VfXGHALx9OY;full][/previewyoutube]

About Nomads of Driftland: The Forgotten Passage
Nomads: The Forgotten Passage is the scenario pack for Nomads of Driftland. This expansion pack is a collection of 10 new maps connected by a loose storyline that provides the background for the missions that can be completed in your preferred order. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1436970/Nomads_of_Driftland_The_Forgotten_Passage/

About Driftland The Magic revival
Base game - Driftland: The Magic Revival is a unique fusion of RTS, 4X strategy, and Sim genres in a fantasy world made up of the shattered planet. The player takes on the role of a powerful mage-ruler capable of moving and reshaping parts of the planet. Both game mechanics and history are based on an innovative concept of dynamic topography and issuing orders to individuals with free will.
[previewyoutube=kxgJGyRV3Yw;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/718650/Driftland_The_Magic_Revival/

If you find a bug or have ideas for new game features or improvements, be sure to let us know on the Steam Community or Discord!

Thank you for all the feedback you send us. It is precious, inspiring for us, and allows us to develop the game further.

May your lands remain unshattered
- Star Drifters Team 🧙🏼‍♀️🧙🧙🏿‍♀️🧝
